basis: Clival bone malignancy; cranial nerve compression causes palsies in ~40-60% of skull-base chordomas, extrapolated to this subtype.

decisions.neurologic: involved: direct cranial nerve compression causes persistent palsies in ~40-60% of skull-base chordomas; subtype-specific frequency is uncertain.

basis: Autoimmune neuromuscular-junction disease defined by extraocular and eyelid dysfunction, with ptosis and ophthalmoplegia.

decisions.ocular: primary: eyelid and ocular motor dysfunction define this subtype; loss of function qualifies without intrinsic globe injury.

basis: Autoimmune glomerular injury; the same anti-GBM process causes pulmonary capillary injury and alveolar hemorrhage in ~40-60%.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: pulmonary hemorrhage affects ~40-60% of anti-GBM disease, a supplied synonym; this concept is not explicitly restricted to renal-limited disease.

basis: Chronic HTLV-1-associated infective eczema; nasal discharge and anterior-nares crusting do not establish airway damage. Later leukemia and myelopathy are separate diseases.

decisions.pulmonary: none: nasal discharge and anterior-nares crusting are diagnostic signs but do not establish damaging airway inflammation or loss of function.

basis: Pneumatoceles, intestinal bleeding and scoliosis each 2/2; ileus/myositis 1/2. Cytopenias, hepatic, renal, skin and neurologic findings each 1/2 omitted by cap.

decisions.haematologic: none: autoimmune cytopenias in 1/2 qualify but are omitted by the four-axis cap; splenomegaly in 2/2 alone does not establish functional damage.
decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: intestinal bleeding in 2/2 supports bowel injury; paralytic ileus in 1/2 adds functional impairment. Celiac disease alone is excluded as separate.

basis: Cardiac and skeletal malformations characterize NS6; motor delay 9/12 and intellectual disability 2/5 support neurologic involvement. Cosmetic skin findings lack functional damage.

decisions.dermatologic: none: keratosis pilaris in 4/9 and pigmentary changes exceed 30%, but do not establish significant inflammation, tissue injury or impaired skin function.

basis: Sterol biosynthesis defect with defining microcephaly, developmental impairment and cataract; dermatitis/ichthyosis in 1/1. Skeletal maturation abnormalities omitted by cap.

decisions.ocular: primary: congenital/developmental cataract is a defining feature, reported in 1/1 annotated patients.
decisions.dermatologic: involved: defining psoriasiform dermatitis and ichthyosis occur in 1/1; assigned here because primary is capped at three axes.

basis: CNS hemosiderin deposition causes neurodegeneration; progressive sensorineural hearing loss is defining and occurs in 80-99%. Bleeding does not establish a coagulation disorder.

decisions.otologic: primary: progressive sensorineural hearing loss is explicitly defining and affects 80-99%; the otologic axis includes hearing.

basis: Axonal sensorimotor neuropathy with pyramidal involvement; persistent denervation causes distal muscle atrophy and structural foot deformity in most patients (>30%).

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: lasting distal muscle atrophy and pes cavus are characteristic in most patients (>30%), representing structural damage integral to CMT2.

basis: Glycine metabolism defect described in one patient; fatigability and elevated CK do not firmly establish damaging myopathy. Odor does not indicate skin injury.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: fatigability and elevated CK are annotated at 80-99% but derive from one case; lasting muscle damage or a defined myopathy is not established.
